notes: Verkada is cloud-managed (Verkada Command); RTSP 1.0 (RFC 2326) is off by default and must be enabled per camera in Command (Cameras > camera > Settings > Device > Real Time Streaming Protocol) by a Site Admin, who sets a dedicated RTSP username and password there. Command shows the ready-made standard and high-resolution URLs to copy (and can export a CSV of all RTSP-enabled cameras). RTSP uses port 8554, not 554. Streams are reachable only from RFC 1918 private addresses on the local network; max 2 concurrent RTSP streams per camera. Resolution and bitrate match the HQ/SQ streams in Command and the codec follows the camera's configured codec (H.264 or H.265). Multisensor cameras (CH52-E, CH53-E, CH63-E, CY53-E, CY63-E) need the per-sensor camera ID before the quality segment (/<camera-id>/high, /<camera-id>/standard; 2 streams per sensor) — copy the exact URL from Command. The CR63-E remote camera does not support RTSP. No ONVIF.
